description: Performance test: Large file (10KB) modified externally, hash check should be efficient
prompt:
1. Read the large file:
<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/large.js"}
</context-item>

2. Edit the first line using replace-text:
<action execute="replace-text">
{"path": "src/large.js", "old_str": "export const LARGE_CONFIG = {", "new_str": "export const LARGE_CONFIG = { modified: true,"}
</action>

NOTE: The 10KB file will be modified externally. Hash computation should be fast (under 50ms).
